name: Cloak Probe (research)
description: Research for an invisibility ability: can a Helldiver wear the Stalker's cloak? On a Terminid mission with a Stalker near you: F12 logs the Stalker's meshes and materials and what the engine lets a mod do with them; Ctrl+F12 puts the Stalker's materials on your Helldiver's meshes behind a smoke puff; Shift+F12 puts yours back. Also logs every explosion near you (throw a G-3 Smoke to learn its row). Needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. Host or solo. Turn off when done.
